title: Synthetic Heart Disease Dataset - 100 Patients
subtitle: 100 synthetic patient records for beginner ML and data visualization
description: This dataset contains exactly 100 synthetic patient records with 20 clinical features for beginner-level machine learning and data visualization practice. The data was generated algorithmically using probabilistic risk-factor relationships. Target distribution: 46 Heart Disease (positive) / 54 No Heart Disease (negative). This is SYNTHETIC data for educational use only — NOT real patient data, NOT clinically validated, NOT for medical diagnosis. The original Kaggle BRFSS Heart Disease Health Indicators dataset was used only as a reference for realistic risk-factor patterns; no records were copied from the source.
